name: Team dhRuVa
description: dhRuVa is the astrophysics club at RV College of Engineering. What began as a quest to explore the secrets of the universe is now a growing team of amateur astrophysics enthusiasts. We constantly try to keep up with the happenings of the universe through our in-house telescopes and radio antennae while hosting stargazing events, astrophysics-related coding competitions, and podcasts featuring celebrated scientists from ICTS to engage the student community. Beyond events and observation, our research has been presented at international and national conferences like GLEX and YATI. Join us on our journey to unravel the stars.
